name: souqna-security-tests
description: Development-only checks for Souqna; does not deploy Firebase

scripts.test: npm run test:source && npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:storage && npm run test:staging-rules && npm run test:gallery-e2e
scripts.test:release: npm run test:source && npm run test:build-isolation && npm run build:hosting
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/ad-media.test.mjs tests/local-services.test.mjs tests/staging-guards.test.mjs tests/inline-module-syntax.test.mjs tests/services-mount.test.mjs tests/gallery-paths.test.mjs tests/server-ad-deletion.test.mjs tests/delete-ad-behavior.test.mjs tests/auto-staging-setup.test.mjs
scripts.test:staging-rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.staging.json --project demo-souqna-staging-rules --only auth,firestore "node --test tests/staging-ads-delete.test.mjs"
scripts.test:gallery-e2e: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.staging.json --project demo-souqna-gallery-flow --only auth,firestore,storage "node --test tests/gallery-e2e.test.mjs"
